comment: The operations both mobile apps time, the milliseconds each may take before it counts as slow, and the metric name each is reported under in the anonymous batch (`wire`; the desktop app already reports app_launch_ms and conversation_load_ms under the same names). Android reports them from Perf.kt (PerfSpan), iOS from PerfMonitor.swift (PerfSpan); each app's parity test checks its own source against this file. Frame cost is reported as frame_cost_ms on Android and main_turn_ms on iOS: the two measure different things, so they have different names.

strings.shareFootnote: Sends numbers only: how long things took, grouped into ranges, your device model and the app and OS versions, under a random id that changes on every launch. No chat content, account or device identifiers. You can turn this off at any time.

iosStrings.shareFootnote: Off until you choose to share. Sends how long things took, grouped into ranges, your device model, refresh rate and the app and OS versions, under a random id that changes on every launch. No chat content, account or persistent device identifiers. Reports are retained for 90 days. You can turn this off at any time.
